risks.title: Client concentration and reliance on large clients
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in the Risk Factors section (high placement), direct language (« If any of our largest clients terminates »), major financial impact on revenue, stable but structural trend in IT services business.

risks.title: Attracting and retaining highly skilled IT talent
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned twice in Risk Factors (« must attract and retain », « attrition »), urgent tone, direct impact on operating costs and growth capacity, critical for service-based model.

risks.title: Intense competition and technological innovation
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited (« We face intense competition »), moderate but repeated language, risk of market share and pricing power erosion, context of rapid innovation (AI, cloud, ML mentioned).

risks.title: Solution quality and liability risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk (« Degradation of the quality »), strong language (« disruptions », « liability »), impact on reputation and client retention, relevant for provider of customized software solutions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and client data compliance
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (« risks related to cybersecurity and data privacy »), contractual obligation language (« contractual security obligations »), risk of client indemnification, relevant for IT service provider.

risks.title: Dependence on IT service demand in limited sectors
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited (« revenue is dependent on a limited number of industry verticals »), sector concentration risk, impact on growth if sectors decline, relevant for verticalized service model.

risks.title: Geopolitical and economic instability in Brazil
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking statements (« uncertainty concerning the current economic, political, and social environment in Latin America, specifically in Brazil »), impact on operations and regulation, headquarters located in Brazil.

risks.title: Long sales cycles and significant investments
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited (« long selling cycle »), impact on cash flow and resource allocation, moderate but structural risk in complex IT services model.
